"import { create } from 'zustand';\nimport { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';\n\ninterface SectionState {\n  [docId: string]: {\n    [sectionId: string]: boolean;\n  };\n}\n\ninterface GraphState {\n  zoom: number;\n  pan: { x: number; y: number };\n}\n\ninterface AppState {\n  // Current document\n  selectedDocumentId: string | null;\n  setSelectedDocumentId: (id: string | null) => void;\n\n  // Section expand/collapse state\n  sectionStates: SectionState;\n  toggleSection: (docId: string, sectionId: string) => void;\n  isSectionExpanded: (docId: string, sectionId: string) => boolean;\n  expandSection: (docId: string, sectionId: string) => void;\n\n  // Graph state\n  graphState: GraphState;\n  setGraphZoom: (zoom: number) => void;\n  setGraphPan: (pan: { x: number; y: number }) => void;\n\n  // Favorites\n  favorites: string[];\n  toggleFavorite: (docId: string) => void;\n  isFavorite: (docId: string) => boolean;\n  getFavoriteCount: () => number;\n\n  // Module filter\n  selectedModule: string | null;\n  setSelectedModule: (module: string | null) => void;\n\n  // Search\n  searchQuery: string;\n  setSearchQuery: (query: string) => void;\n\n  // Sort\n  sortBy: 'title' | 'date' | 'module';\n  setSortBy: (sort: 'title' | 'date' | 'module') => void;\n\n  // Toast/Prompt\n  toast: { message: string; type: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' } | null;\n  showToast: (message: string, type: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error') => void;\n  hideToast: () => void;\n}\n\nexport const useAppStore = create<AppState>()(\n  persist(\n    (set, get) => ({\n      selectedDocumentId: null,\n      setSelectedDocumentId: (id) => set({ selectedDocumentId: id }),\n\n      sectionStates: {},\n      toggleSection: (docId, sectionId) => set((state) => ({\n        sectionStates: {\n          ...state.sectionStates,\n          [docId]: {\n            ...state.sectionStates[docId],\n            [sectionId]: !state.sectionStates[docId]?.[sectionId]\n          }\n        }\n      })),\n      isSectionExpanded: (docId, sectionId) => {\n        return get().sectionStates[docId]?.[sectionId] ?? false;\n      },\n      expandSection: (docId, sectionId) => set((state) => ({\n        sectionStates: {\n          ...state.sectionStates,\n          [docId]: {\n            ...state.sectionStates[docId],\n            [sectionId]: true\n          }\n        }\n      })),\n\n      graphState: { zoom: 1, pan: { x: 0, y: 0 } },\n      setGraphZoom: (zoom) => set((state) => ({\n        graphState: { ...state.graphState, zoom }\n      })),\n      setGraphPan: (pan) => set((state) => ({\n        graphState: { ...state.graphState, pan }\n      })),\n\n      favorites: [],\n      toggleFavorite: (docId) => set((state) => ({\n        favorites: state.favorites.includes(docId)\n          ? state.favorites.filter(id => id !== docId)\n          : [...state.favorites, docId]\n      })),\n      isFavorite: (docId) => get().favorites.includes(docId),\n      getFavoriteCount: () => get().favorites.length,\n\n      selectedModule: null,\n      setSelectedModule: (module) => set({ selectedModule: module }),\n\n      searchQuery: '',\n      setSearchQuery: (query) => set({ searchQuery: query }),\n\n      sortBy: 'title',\n      setSortBy: (sort) => set({ sortBy: sort }),\n\n      toast: null,\n      showToast: (message, type) => {\n        set({ toast: { message, type } });\n        setTimeout(() => set({ toast: null }), 3000);\n      },\n      hideToast: () => set({ toast: null })\n    }),\n    {\n      name: 'tech-docs-storage',\n      partialize: (state) => ({\n        favorites: state.favorites,\n        sectionStates: state.sectionStates,\n        graphState: state.graphState,\n        selectedModule: state.selectedModule,\n        sortBy: state.sortBy\n      })\n    }\n  )\n);\n"

### Result
"import { useMemo, useCallback, useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { documents, getDocumentById, ModuleType, moduleInfo } from '@/data/documents';\nimport { useAppStore } from '@/store/appStore';\nimport { motion } from 'framer-motion';\nimport { ZoomIn, ZoomOut, RotateCcw, Maximize2 } from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface Node {\n  id: string;\n  label: string;\n  module: ModuleType;\n  x: number;\n  y: number;\n}\n\ninterface Edge {\n  from: string;\n  to: string;\n}\n\nconst MODULE_COLORS: Record<ModuleType, string> = {\n  api: 'hsl(187, 85%, 53%)',\n  auth: 'hsl(271, 81%, 56%)',\n  data: 'hsl(142, 71%, 45%)',\n  ui: 'hsl(38, 92%, 50%)',\n  core: 'hsl(346, 77%, 50%)'\n};\n\nexport function KnowledgeGraph() {\n  const { graphState, setGraphZoom, setGraphPan, setSelectedDocumentId, expandSection, showToast, selectedDocumentId } = useAppStore();\n  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState({ width: 800, height: 600 });\n  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);\n  const dragStart = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const updateDimensions = () => {\n      if (containerRef.current) {\n        setDimensions({\n          width: containerRef.current.clientWidth,\n          height: containerRef.current.clientHeight\n        });\n      }\n    };\n\n    updateDimensions();\n    window.addEventListener('resize', updateDimensions);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', updateDimensions);\n  }, []);\n\n  // Generate node positions in a circular layout grouped by module\n  const { nodes, edges } = useMemo(() => {\n    const moduleGroups = new Map<ModuleType, typeof documents>();\n    documents.forEach(doc => {\n      const group = moduleGroups.get(doc.module) || [];\n      group.push(doc);\n      moduleGroups.set(doc.module, group);\n    });\n\n    const centerX = dimensions.width / 2;\n    const centerY = dimensions.height / 2;\n    const moduleRadius = Math.min(dimensions.width, dimensions.height) * 0.35;\n    const nodeRadius = 60;\n\n    const nodes: Node[] = [];\n    const moduleTypes = Array.from(moduleGroups.keys());\n    \n    moduleTypes.forEach((module, moduleIndex) => {\n      const moduleAngle = (moduleIndex / moduleTypes.length) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;\n      const moduleCenterX = centerX + Math.cos(moduleAngle) * moduleRadius;\n      const moduleCenterY = centerY + Math.sin(moduleAngle) * moduleRadius;\n\n      const docs = moduleGroups.get(module) || [];\n      docs.forEach((doc, docIndex) => {\n        const docAngle = (docIndex / docs.length) * 2 * Math.PI;\n        const docRadius = Math.min(nodeRadius * docs.length * 0.4, 80);\n        \n        nodes.push({\n          id: doc.id,\n          label: doc.title,\n          module: doc.module,\n          x: moduleCenterX + Math.cos(docAngle) * docRadius,\n          y: moduleCenterY + Math.sin(docAngle) * docRadius\n        });\n      });\n    });\n\n    const edges: Edge[] = [];\n    documents.forEach(doc => {\n      doc.relatedDocs.forEach(relatedId => {\n        // Avoid duplicate edges\n        if (!edges.some(e => \n          (e.from === doc.id && e.to === relatedId) || \n          (e.from === relatedId && e.to === doc.id)\n        )) {\n          edges.push({ from: doc.id, to: relatedId });\n        }\n      });\n    });\n\n    return { nodes, edges };\n  }, [dimensions]);\n\n  const handleNodeClick = useCallback((nodeId: string) => {\n    const doc = getDocumentById(nodeId);\n    if (!doc) {\n      showToast('Document not found', 'error');\n      return;\n    }\n    setSelectedDocumentId(nodeId);\n    if (doc.sections.length > 0) {\n      expandSection(nodeId, doc.sections[0].id);\n    }\n  }, [setSelectedDocumentId, expandSection, showToast]);\n\n  const handleZoomIn = () => setGraphZoom(Math.min(graphState.zoom + 0.2, 3));\n  const handleZoomOut = () => setGraphZoom(Math.max(graphState.zoom - 0.2, 0.3));\n  const handleReset = () => {\n    setGraphZoom(1);\n    setGraphPan({ x: 0, y: 0 });\n  };\n\n  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {\n    if (e.target === containerRef.current?.querySelector('svg')) {\n      setIsDragging(true);\n      dragStart.current = { x: e.clientX - graphState.pan.x, y: e.clientY - graphState.pan.y };\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {\n    if (isDragging) {\n      setGraphPan({\n        x: e.clientX - dragStart.current.x,\n        y: e.clientY - dragStart.current.y\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleMouseUp = () => setIsDragging(false);\n\n  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const delta = e.deltaY > 0 ? -0.1 : 0.1;\n    setGraphZoom(Math.max(0.3, Math.min(3, graphState.zoom + delta)));\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div ref={containerRef} className=\"h-full relative overflow-hidden bg-background\">\n      {/* Controls */}\n      <div className=\"absolute top-4 right-4 z-10 flex gap-2\">\n        <button\n          onClick={handleZoomIn}\n          className=\"p-2 bg-secondary hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-lg transition-colors\"\n          title=\"Zoom In\"\n        >\n          <ZoomIn size={18} className=\"text-foreground\" />\n        </button>\n        <button\n          onClick={handleZoomOut}\n          className=\"p-2 bg-secondary hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-lg transition-colors\"\n          title=\"Zoom Out\"\n        >\n          <ZoomOut size={18} className=\"text-foreground\" />\n        </button>\n        <button\n          onClick={handleReset}\n          className=\"p-2 bg-secondary hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-lg transition-colors\"\n          title=\"Reset View\"\n        >\n          <RotateCcw size={18} className=\"text-foreground\" />\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Legend */}\n      <div className=\"absolute bottom-4 left-4 z-10 bg-card/90 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border rounded-lg p-3\">\n        <div className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2 font-medium\">Modules</div>\n        <div className=\"space-y-1.5\">\n          {Object.entries(moduleInfo).map(([key, info]) => (\n            <div key={key} className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n              <div\n                className=\"w-3 h-3 rounded-full\"\n                style={{ backgroundColor: MODULE_COLORS[key as ModuleType] }}\n              />\n              <span className=\"text-xs text-foreground\">{info.name}</span>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Zoom Level Indicator */}\n      <div className=\"absolute bottom-4 right-4 z-10 bg-card/90 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5\">\n        <span className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\">\n          {Math.round(graphState.zoom * 100)}%\n        </span>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Graph SVG */}\n      <svg\n        width={dimensions.width}\n        height={dimensions.height}\n        className=\"cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing\"\n        onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}\n        onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}\n        onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}\n        onMouseLeave={handleMouseUp}\n        onWheel={handleWheel}\n      >\n        <g transform={`translate(${graphState.pan.x}, ${graphState.pan.y}) scale(${graphState.zoom})`}>\n          {/* Edges */}\n          {edges.map((edge, i) => {\n            const fromNode = nodes.find(n => n.id === edge.from);\n            const toNode = nodes.find(n => n.id === edge.to);\n            if (!fromNode || !toNode) return null;\n\n            return (\n              <line\n                key={`edge-${i}`}\n                x1={fromNode.x}\n                y1={fromNode.y}\n                x2={toNode.x}\n                y2={toNode.y}\n                stroke=\"hsl(222, 30%, 25%)\"\n                strokeWidth={1.5}\n                strokeOpacity={0.5}\n              />\n            );\n          })}\n\n          {/* Nodes */}\n          {nodes.map((node) => {\n            const isSelected = selectedDocumentId === node.id;\n            const color = MODULE_COLORS[node.module];\n            \n            return (\n              <g\n                key={node.id}\n                className=\"graph-node\"\n                onClick={() => handleNodeClick(node.id)}\n                style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}\n              >\n                {/* Glow effect for selected node */}\n                {isSelected && (\n                  <circle\n                    cx={node.x}\n                    cy={node.y}\n                    r={28}\n                    fill={color}\n                    opacity={0.3}\n                    className=\"animate-pulse-glow\"\n                  />\n                )}\n                \n                {/* Node circle */}\n
